title: Seasonal Surge Simulator and Commitment Guardrails for Hosted Endpoints & Model Fleet
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a scenario-driven quarterly runway exercise that simulates seasonal demand surges across hosted endpoints and produces a concrete commitment+hedge plan for the model catalog. Deliverables: 1) a reproducible surge simulator that can intake per-endpoint traffic shapes and produce capacity and latency risk projections, 2) a decision playbook with commitment lanes (Baseline, Hedge, Surge), and 3) a prioritized model-fleet gating plan that maps endpoints to model tiers and rollback/fallback rules. This ticket coordinates PM + Eng + Design to produce the playbook, run two live simulations (nominal + 2x seasonal surge), and publish canary windows and staffing/training notes for SRE/ops teams.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator accepts CSV or JSON workload trace and outputs capacity delta, expected p95 latency, and cost delta per model variant
Commitment playbook defines three lanes (Baseline / Hedge / Surge) with actionable rules for switching lanes and thresholds for autoscaling and dedicated reservations
Model catalog priority mapping is published and includes fallback chains and quantization/latency tradeoffs for each endpoint
Runbooks and canary windows documented and linked to Console dashboards; SRE sign-off obtained
Two scenario runs completed (expected Q3 seasonal and stress case) with run artifacts uploaded to Drive and key takeaways shared in cross-functional review
